checkbox: The repository names exactly one selected track.
A reviewer can create/select an Agent and run a task from the browser.
The selected middleware executes in a real backend/runtime path.
The demo includes both a positive case and a failure, denial, or malicious case.
No secret appears in source, browser state, screenshots, logs, traces, or demo output.
The README contains deployment steps and known limitations.

ul.li: Glass Box: a correlated trace identifies a failing step and reports available model usage.
Bouncer: cross-user access is denied by the backend and the decision identifies human, Agent, action, and resource.
Kill Switch: a malicious action is contained, the protected asset survives, and execution cleanup is visible.

callout.p: A static mock, verbal-only design, or middleware check implemented only in the browser does not pass acceptance.
